# Shashank Kesarwani, Senior Product Designer

> Senior Product Designer with 5+ years shipping consumer products in India (EdTech and consumer apps). Currently designing Dalvoy, a 0 to 1 EdTech product (4 lakh+ registered users, 12K DAU / 94K MAU, Day-30 retention improved 3% to 10%, 30%+ organic growth). Previously at SpeakX, where his work reached 10M+ users: Day-0 activation on the paid base lifted from 25.5% to 60.7%, paid checkout conversion +38.8%, and the company's first design system. Based in Gurugram, India. Portfolio: https://www.shashankkesarwani.com

## Case studies

- [Dalvoy, 0 to 1](https://www.shashankkesarwani.com/case-studies/dalvoy/): founding designer on a UPSC and govt-exam prep app; the result-analysis engine, Mains answer evaluation, and Dalvoy Shorts. 4 lakh+ registered users, average session 15 to 24 minutes.
- [UPI-first checkout](https://www.shashankkesarwani.com/case-studies/upi-checkout/): rebuilt SpeakX checkout around UPI as the default payment path. ~3× conversion on the UPI cohort, payment success rate up ~10 points, 99% checkout-load reach.
- [Result Page redesign](https://www.shashankkesarwani.com/case-studies/result-page-redesign/): turned the end-of-lesson scorecard into the engagement and monetisation hinge of the lesson loop, across four layered A/B tests. Practice +19.5%, payment success +30.8% on the headline release.
- [Gamified read-along](https://www.shashankkesarwani.com/case-studies/read-along-gamified/): points, streaks and per-word feedback on the read-along lesson, tested head-to-head over four days at ~2K paid users per bucket. +2.7 points day-zero activation, −1.7 points cancellation.
- [Membership page redesign](https://www.shashankkesarwani.com/case-studies/speakx-membership/): rebuilt the screen subscribers saw before cancelling to lead with learning progress. −8% in-app cancellations, −3% Day-0 cancellations, +1% Day-0 engagement.
